title: bromus lepidus f. lasiolepis
intro: Bromus lepidus f. lasiolepis, commonly known as Mountain Brome or Fescue-leaved Brome, is a perennial grass species native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include its ability to act as a diuretic, reduce inflammation, and aid in digestion.
